heading: Video | Unclear if Higher Commodity Costs Can Be Fully Passed On: Seth Freeman
paragraphs: Commodity producers and manufacturers may struggle to pass on the full impact of rising input costs to customers, according to Seth R. Freeman of GlassRatner Advisory, who said demand conditions will determine pricing power. Freeman also flagged long-dated US Treasuries as an attractive investment opportunity, saying current yields on 10-year bonds offer a compelling entry point for investors.
